fieldValues.name: srs-web
fieldValues.tagline: Edit SRS repositories entirely client-side, on storage you own.
fieldValues.summary: An opinionated browser editor, thin over the WASM core. It works against local files, Dropbox, Google Drive and GitHub, and includes an agents panel.
fieldValues.audience: People who work with structured knowledge and want it to stay theirs.
fieldValues.makes_possible: Reading and editing a repository with nothing to install, while the files stay in your own storage.
